answer: In our Proof of Agent network, nodes bind an ivory hardware key to a verifiable stake-slashing vault. When rogue identities wander across clusters attempting collusion, the protocol forces quadratic burn of deposited collateral: maintaining n forged agents demands a superlinear cost scaling as O(n^2.5). Every minted jade credential enforces unforgeable proof-of-burn verification, imposing prohibitive economic friction against Sybil replicas.
